item.title: Indian Coast Guard busts international oil cargo smuggling syndicate in a daring mid sea operation
item.description: NEW DELHI: The Indian Coast Guard busted an international oil smuggling racket on Friday through an intricate sea-air network. item.title: Sonia Gandhi opposes revision plea in electoral roll case, calls allegations misleading
item.description: NEW DELHI: A reply has been filed on behalf of Sonia Gandhi before the Rouse Avenue Court opposing the revision petition that alleges her name was fraudulently included in the voter list before she acquired Indian citizenship. item.title: 6 killed, 3 injured as truck rams into bus on Yamuna Expressway in Mathura
item.description: MATHURA: Six people were killed and three were injured when a container truck rammed into a bus, and ran over passengers standing in front of the parked vehicle on the Yamuna Expressway in the early hours of Saturday, police here said.
